## New checkpoint: the actual germ detects every nonstandard positive cycle

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint proves a new written prime-denominator obstruction for every hypothetical nonstandard positive ordinary cycle, with a finite Lean core and independent reviews. It strengthens the frozen arithmetic-germ route from eventual periodicity to convergence to one. The required full germ and limiting parity density have not been constructed for every source.

- **Published head:** e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3
- **Tree:** e388d0eb89603a5b0a44c828deef9db325af8ffd
- **Single parent:** afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b
- [Scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/research/profound-round6-20261123/README.md)
- [Proof, review, and execution index](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/reports/2026-11-23-profound-round6/README.md)

### 1. A denominator prime that survives every actual prefix and polynomial cancellation

For one positive ordinary source, use the shortcut map, its actual parities e_k, and cumulative odd counts p_k. Put

\[
B_n(z)=\sum_{k\ge0}e_k3^{-p_{k+1}}z^k,\qquad
J_n(t)=B_n(2+t)=\sum_{j\ge0}c_jt^j.
\]

The full affine identity gives only the known binary value c_0=-n.

If this actual orbit is eventually periodic, let the cycle have shortcut length A and p odd inputs, and put g=gcd(A,p), u=A/g, v=p/g. For every prime ell dividing D_red=2^u-3^v, the new written theorem proves

\[
\boxed{
\limsup_{j\to\infty}\frac{v_\ell(\operatorname{den}(c_j))}{j}
\ge \frac{v_\ell(D_{\rm red})}{u}>0.
}
\]

The proof first keeps the complete repeated-block denominator 3^p-z^A and the complete chronological carry. At its positive real root, the numerator after any actual prefix is strictly positive. Hence the irreducible factor z^u-3^v survives in the reduced rational-function denominator, along with every conjugate pole at every completion. The translated pole distance gives the coefficient-denominator growth.

The full valuation in **D_red** is retained. No claim is made that every prime power of the larger integer 2^A-3^p survives. This is polynomial noncancellation before evaluation, not a replacement of full-cycle integrality by a proper-factor test.

[Complete proof and exact source conditions](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/research/profound-round6-20261123/RATIONAL_SELECTION.md) · [independent cycle arithmetic reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/research/profound-round6-20261123/CYCLE_ARITHMETIC.md).

### 2. Prime-three germs force the standard positive cycle

The actual positive odd-cycle equations give

\[
3^p<2^A=\prod_i(3+1/q_i)\le4^p.
\]

If D_red=1, a modulo-eight calculation forces (u,v)=(2,1), and equality in the product bound forces every odd state to be one. Therefore a nonstandard positive ordinary cycle has D_red>1 coprime to six. Its required external denominator prime is incompatible with every actual Taylor coefficient lying in Z[1/3].

Consequently, for sources already known to be eventually periodic,

\[
J_n\in\mathbb Z[1/3][[t]]
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad n\text{ reaches }1.
\]

Define J3 to require this full actual coefficient ring and positive complex and ternary convergence radii. Combining the result with PR178's general-density consumer at **398b3a04da071e96362005792417bd5cf8cc6497** gives

\[
\boxed{
\text{For a fixed ordinary source whose parity density has a limit,}
\qquad J3(n)\Longleftrightarrow n\text{ reaches }1.
}
\]

The converse has a stronger common denominator: if a known actual prefix a reaches one after tau steps containing s odd inputs, then

\[
3^sJ_n(t)=C_a(2+t)-\frac{(2+t)^\tau}{1+4t+t^2}\in\mathbb Z[[t]].
\]

The external machinery is Chambert-Loir–Noûs's multipoint rationality theorem. Its integral model, compatible local realizations, strict game margin, and the exact upstream small-hole calculation were independently checked. The general analytic theorem and its Collatz application are **source-qualified written mathematics**, not a Lean formalization here. The source retains limiting density and the entire arithmetic germ; the scalar value -n supplies neither.

### 3. An explicit cancellation control

The positive rational, nonordinary cycle with word 110000 starts at 1/11 and has

\[
B(z)=\frac{3+z}{9-z^6},\quad D=55,\quad C(2)=5,\quad D_{\rm red}=5.
\]

Its constant value is -1/11, but its derivative is 181/605. The prime five disappears from the value and reappears in the actual derivative. A short recurrence induction proves v_5(den(c_j))=j for all j>=1; the replay separately checks orders 1 through 31.

[Exact control, induction, and finite-scope boundaries](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/research/profound-round6-20261123/EXACT_CONTROLS.md).

### 4. Complete finite collision packing and the missing transfer rate

For N distinct actual ordinary states of maximum H_N, the entire empirical law satisfies

\[
\frac1N\le\operatorname{Col}_Q(\pi_N)
\le\frac{\lfloor H_N/Q\rfloor+1}{N}.
\]

The injection keeps the first ordinary source and the complete quotient of the second. Every ordered pair, ordinary diagonal, and cross-collision is retained. For any comparison law mu,

\[
\|\pi_N\bmod Q-\mu\bmod Q\|_{\rm TV}
\ge\frac1{\sqrt2}
\left(\sqrt{\operatorname{Col}_Q(\mu)}
-\sqrt{\frac{\lfloor H_N/Q\rfloor+1}{N}}\right)_+.
\]

At growing Q=N^(kappa+o(1)), this gives an explicit discrepancy obstruction when H_N<=N^(beta+o(1)), the proposed limit has collision at least c Q^(-d), kappa*d<1, and beta<1+kappa*(1-d). The sharp critical iid alternative at the pinned PR180 has d=0.705155598..., giving the conditional threshold 1/d=1.418126727....

No iid law is substituted for an actual ordinary orbit, and no actual convergence rate or height upper is established. The O(1/N) comparison between two finite actual flows does not supply their rate of convergence to a stationary limit. [Full collision note](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/research/profound-round6-20261123/COLLISION_CLOSURE.md).

### Validation and independent review

- **17 new public Lean theorems:** seven chronological polynomial statements, six actual positive-cycle arithmetic statements, and four complete finite-source collision statements.
- Fresh output directory; both local dependencies recompiled; three new modules and the complete audit compiled successfully in **six commands**.
- Lean 4.34.1, compiler **5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52**; Mathlib **d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612**; one worker, warnings as errors, autoImplicit=false.
- Axiom union: **propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound**. The entire older authored corpus was not rebuilt; all **47** prior tracked Lean files were verified unchanged.
- Normal and optimized Python replay both passed with byte-identical output and explicit checks active under -O.
- **1,578** primitive positive rational words through length ten; **14,338** literal rational steps; **1,269** reduced-prime instances; **82** instances cancelled at the constant value and seen later within the finite coefficient range.
- **4,192** independently constructed Taylor coefficients across **131** ordinary convergent sources; all tested denominators divide the actual prefix's common power 3^s.
- **409,264** complete ordered collision pairs, including **390,638** off-diagonal pairs, across **2,071** actual source/modulus cases; **6,184** exact probability comparisons.
- [Independent germ review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/reports/2026-11-23-profound-round6/JET_REVIEW.md), [independent collision review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/reports/2026-11-23-profound-round6/COLLISION_REVIEW.md), and [root reconstruction/execution boundary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/reports/2026-11-23-profound-round6/ROOT_REVIEW.md) are bound to exact source contents. No mathematical correction was required.

The analytic radius theorem, binomial irreducibility application, arithmetic rationality theorem, total-variation asymptotics, and stationary limits are not claimed as Lean-checked. Finite computations do not prove an all-time germ or an unrestricted cycle exclusion.

### Exact published checkout gate

The complete **560-file** detached checkout of **e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3** passed all five default commands of python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py. Its commit, tree, and clean status were unchanged after execution.

All **21** bound science/review/execution files, **47** earlier Lean files, **six** compiled source inputs, and **eight** exact replay inputs match the published bytes. All **537** parent files are unchanged; this checkpoint adds **23** files.

Final gate receipt SHA-256: **085010ee439e6f63c30a74ce1c8d619847e77c14b3d2f22fb5fe4abfd691e6f4**

Source binding SHA-256: **1bf863dc9734b05f4e27c19844feaca63ab9ad61b472aaa6ceaec60de7c3906d**

The branch was advanced without force, using the exact previous head as a compare-and-swap guard. Fresh GitHub reads confirmed the branch and PR head before this summary. The existing draft state and base branch are retained.

### Continuity and remaining work

This extends the existing PR. [The previous title, body, head, and base](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e4367dd2c4406c1041e66d82dfba822908747fa3/reports/2026-11-23-profound-round6/PR182_BEFORE.json) and all earlier checkpoints remain preserved.

The next substantial obligation is to construct J3 for an arbitrary fixed positive ordinary source, together with limiting density, or prove an ordinary-source condition that replaces them. Even rationality of the first unknown derivative is not obtained here. The separate collision and all-branch pressure approaches retain their explicit source-transfer and lower-comparison gaps. The new theorem removes the additional nonstandard-cycle obligation from the stated conditional germ route; it does not solve the construction problem.
